_schema.purpose: Conservative heuristic that heal_unregistered_approval.py uses to decide which larry-alerts.jsonl escalations are APPROVAL-CLASS direction-asks that should be promoted onto the dashboard Approvals tab. An alert qualifies when route == 'escalate' AND it carries a decision signal: its suggested_action matches one of suggested_action_prefixes (case-insensitive, at the start, word-boundary) OR its message/subject contains one of decision_phrases (case-insensitive substring). Favor catching a real decision over silence: a false positive is a dismissible tab card; a false negative is the stranded-direction-ask bug this healer kills. Edit this file (no code change) to widen/narrow the net.
_schema.tuning_notes: Keep prefixes/phrases SPECIFIC to decisions Larry must direct. Routine infra escalations (install-drift, tier2-probe, pipeline-stall) deliberately do NOT match — their suggested_action starts with operator commands ('On the droplet', 'Re-auth', 'Check ...'), not a decision verb.
